title: The Image Hover Effects Ultimate ( Image Gallery, Effects, Lightbox, Comparison & Magnifier ) plugin for WordPress is…
description: The Image Hover Effects Ultimate WordPress plugin (up to version 9.12.2) contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the 'rawdata.oxi_image_comparison_before_text' parameter. Authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher can exploit this when the plugin's "Who can edit" setting is configured to allow subscribers to edit styles. This lack of ownership checks enables injection of arbitrary scripts that execute when a user views the affected page.
